checklist.title: Falsify EIP-7044 signing domain permanence across fork upgrades
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Initialize a beacon state at a post-Capella fork (e.g., Deneb). 2. Compute the voluntary exit signing domain and record the domain value. 3. Simulate a fork transition to a subsequent fork (e.g., Electra). 4. Recompute the voluntary exit signing domain on the upgraded state. 5. Assert both domains are identical and equal to the Capella fork version domain. 6. Attempt to inject a modified fork version into the domain computation path and verify it is rejected or ignored.
executable_checks: assert domain.fork_version == CAPELLA_FORK_VERSION for all post-EIP7044 states
assert voluntary exit signed with non-Capella domain fails verification
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7044-INV-001. Tests STATE-DOMAIN-PERMANENT invariant by attempting state transitions (fork upgrades) that could mutate the signing domain. Related ambiguity: AMB-EIP7044-02.

checklist.title: Falsify Deneb-to-Capella header stripping correctness and root integrity
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a valid Deneb execution payload header with known blob_gas_used and excess_blob_gas values. 2. Apply the blob-gas stripping function. 3. Verify the resulting header has exactly the Capella field set (no extra, no missing fields). 4. Compute hash_tree_root of the stripped header. 5. Compare against independently computed Capella execution root from a reference implementation. 6. Attempt to strip a header with fields in wrong order and verify detection. 7. Inject an extra field after stripping and verify hash_tree_root diverges.
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-DENEB-LC-POSTCOND-001. Tests ACTION-STRIP-BLOB-GAS-FIELDS post-condition by verifying side-effects (field removal) and checking for unexpected state (root mismatch). Related assumption: ASSUM-DENEB-LC-SYNC-01.

checklist.title: Falsify EIP-5345 permission request validation by bypassing individual checks
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a valid permission request that passes all checks (baseline). 2. Mutate chain ID to an invalid value (0, negative, non-existent chain) and verify rejection. 3. Mutate contract address to invalid formats (wrong length, non-hex chars, zero address) and verify rejection. 4. Mutate function selectors to invalid values (3 bytes, 5 bytes, empty) and verify rejection. 5. Set expiry timestamp to past value, current timestamp, and zero, verifying each is rejected. 6. Submit a request with all fields invalid simultaneously and verify it does not partially pass. 7. Verify validation order: confirm that skipping an earlier check does not allow later checks to grant validity.
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP5345-PRECOND-002. Tests STATE-REQUEST-VALIDATED pre-condition by attempting to bypass with invalid inputs at each validation stage. Covers nodes: ACTION-VALIDATE-CHAIN-ID through STATE-REQUEST-VALIDATED.

checklist.title: Falsify explicit base=16 invariant by detecting base=0 or implicit base usage in hex parsing
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Static analysis: Search all call sites of int() used for hex parsing and verify each uses base=16 explicitly. 2. Grep for patterns: int(x, 0) or int(x) where x is hex-like input. 3. Construct test inputs with octal prefix '0o77' and binary prefix '0b1010' and pass to the hex parsing function. 4. If base=16 is enforced, '0o77' should raise ValueError or be parsed as hex (not octal 63). 5. Verify int('0xff', 16) == 255 and int('ff', 16) == 255 both work correctly. 6. Verify int('0o77', 16) raises ValueError (not silently returns 63).
executable_checks: try: int('0o77', 16); assert False, 'should raise ValueError' except ValueError: pass
grep -rn 'int(.*,\s*0)' in hex parsing modules returns zero matches
grep -rn 'int(.*base=0)' in hex parsing modules returns zero matches
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-HEX-INV-004. Tests ACTION-PARSE-INT-HEX invariant by attempting to violate via octal/binary prefix injection. Related assumption: ASSUM-HEXADECIMAL-02.

checklist.title: Falsify out-of-gas immediate revert by attempting trie access after gas exhaustion
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Set up an EVM execution context with gas exactly equal to the cost of a SLOAD (or BALANCE per EIP-1884 repricing). 2. Execute the opcode so gas reaches exactly zero. 3. Attempt a subsequent trie-accessing opcode (SLOAD, BALANCE, EXTCODEHASH). 4. Verify that execution reverts with out-of-gas BEFORE any trie access occurs. 5. Instrument trie access to confirm zero trie reads after gas exhaustion. 6. Test edge case: gas = cost - 1 (should revert on first opcode). 7. Test edge case: gas = cost + 1 (should execute first, then revert on second trie access).
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W1-EIP1884-POSTCOND-002. Tests STATE-OUT-OF-GAS post-condition by verifying no trie access occurs after gas depletion. Covers ACTION-DEDUCT-GAS -> STATE-OUT-OF-GAS -> (no EDGE-EXECUTE to ACTION-EXECUTE-TRIE-ACCESS).
